user_query: My friend is looking for job opportunities in Paris. Can you help him by extracting email and phone data from Pages Jaunes for companies in Paris? Additionally, please extract email and phone data from Pages Blanches for individuals named Patrick in Paris.

TaskList.description: Extract email and phone data for companies located in Paris from Pages Jaunes.
Extract email and phone data for individuals named Patrick residing in Paris from Pages Blanches.
Compile the extracted contact information from both Pages Jaunes and Pages Blanches into a single list.
TaskList.dependency: Step 3 requires the results from steps 1 and 2.
